description: Current open roles from 1-5 company career boards, read live from the board: title, department, location, remote flag, employment type, salary when published, posting date and job URL. Give board URLs (e.g. https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/stripe, https://jobs.lever.co/acme) or platform:slug (greenhouse:stripe). Billed per job returned.

companies.description: 1-5 career board URLs or platform:slug values.

include_descriptions.description: Include the first 1,500 characters of each description as plain text (default false). Not billed extra.

keywords.description: Optional: keep jobs whose title contains any of these.

limit.description: Jobs to return in total (default 20, max 50). Billed per job returned.

locations.description: Optional: city, region or country names or ISO codes.

posted_within_days.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days.

name: company_jobs
title: Open jobs at specific companies
